summary: Tested 3 bug fixes and ML Dashboard enhancement. All tests passed: 1) Ooredoo/DGV tab now refreshes correctly when dates change (billing rate changed from 12.71% to 12.40% after date change), 2) Daily stats tables show dates in YYYY-MM-DD format without timestamps, 3) Eklektik daily table has 'Offre' column with offer names in expanded rows, 4) ML Dashboard has KPIs, charts, model performance section with 3 cards, and 3 configuration buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: main.js line 315-330: ooredoo_stats case now correctly calls updateOoredooKPIs() immediately after data arrives
eklektik.js: Eklektik table rendering includes offer_name column and uses date.split('T')[0] for date formatting
ooredoo.js line 222: stat_date.split('T')[0] strips timestamps from dates
ml-dashboard.blade.php: Enhanced with model performance section showing 3 model cards (Payment Success, Timing Optimizer, Churn Risk)
dashboard.blade.php: Eklektik table header now has 11 columns including 'Offre'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs fixed and verified: 1) Ooredoo/DGV tab refresh works - billing rate updates from 12.71% to 12.40% when date range changes, 2) Date format in daily stats tables is YYYY-MM-DD without timestamps, 3) Eklektik table has 'Offre' column showing offer names like 'Club privileges by Orange DAILY [3day fr...' in expanded rows.
